Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Delivery Date

Dear [Client Name],

I want to share an update on the project timeline. Certifying the third-party integration required for this phase has taken longer than initially planned, and this has pushed our schedule back by two weeks. The certification process involved additional review cycles that were outside our direct control, and we have been working closely with the vendor to move it forward as quickly as possible.

Based on the current status of the certification, we now expect to deliver the completed project on 14 April. Our team is continuing to prepare the remaining components in parallel so that we can move quickly once certification is finalized, and we do not anticipate any further changes to this date.

Does this revised timeline work for your internal planning, or are there any milestones on your end we should factor in before 14 April? We will keep you updated on our progress and are happy to arrange a call if you would like to discuss the details further.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
